name: Exp_Laguerre_ROC
summary: This EA trades based on the Laguerre ROC (Rate of Change) custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator's color buffer transitions upward to level 4 and sell positions when it transitions downward to level 0. It uses configurable overbought/oversold levels (0.75/0.25) and a gamma smoothing parameter to generate signals, with separate controls for opening and closing long/short positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Laguerre ROC自定义指标进行交易，当指标颜色缓冲区向上转至4级时开多仓，向下转至0级时开空仓。它使用可配置的超买/超卖水平(0.75/0.25)和gamma平滑参数生成信号，并对多空仓的开仓和平仓分别提供独立控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Laguerre滤波器平滑的速率变化(ROC)指标作为核心策略。入场条件：当指标颜色缓冲值从低于4变为4时触发买入信号，从高于0变为0时触发卖出信号，这代表动量方向发生了明确的转变。出场条件：当指标颜色缓冲值低于2时平掉多仓，高于2时平掉空仓，这是一种趋势衰竭的出场逻辑。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1，并支持LOT和MARGIN两种仓位计算模式。资金管理方面，EA设置了固定的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)，止盈是止损的2倍，体现了趋势跟踪中让利润奔跑的理念。策略还使用了IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复入场，同时允许通过BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen等布尔参数灵活控制交易方向。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses a Laguerre-filter-smoothed Rate of Change (ROC) indicator as its core strategy. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator's color buffer transitions from below 4 to exactly 4, and a sell signal triggers when it transitions from above 0 to exactly 0, representing a decisive momentum shift. Exit conditions: long positions close when the color buffer drops below 2, and short positions close when it rises above 2, reflecting a trend exhaustion exit logic. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter defaulting to 0.1, with support for both LOT and MARGIN calculation modes. Money management employs fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), with the 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio embodying the trend-following principle of letting profits run. The strategy also uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, while offering boolean toggles for BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen to flexibly control trading direction.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式(手数/保证金)

pros: 使用Laguerre滤波器平滑ROC信号，能有效减少假信号和噪音干扰
多空方向和开平仓均可独立控制，灵活性高
采用新K线检测机制避免同根K线重复交易
止损止盈比例2:1，符合趋势跟踪的风险回报原则
pros_en: Laguerre filter smoothing on ROC effectively reduces false signals and market noise
Independent toggles for buy/sell and open/close provide high flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades within the same bar
2:1 take-profit to stop-loss ratio follows sound trend-following risk-reward principles
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点对于H8周期来说数值较大，可能不适合所有品种
缺少持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
没有点差过滤机制，在点差较大的品种上可能造成不利入场
信号依赖自定义指标的颜色缓冲区(整数级别0-4)，逻辑不透明且难以回测验证
cons_en: Stop loss of 1000 and take profit of 2000 points are large for H8 timeframe and may not suit all instruments
Lacks position checking logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
No spread filter mechanism, which could lead to unfavorable entries on high-spread instruments
Signal relies on custom indicator color buffer (integer levels 0-4), making logic opaque and difficult to backtest independently
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
添加点差和波动率过滤条件，提高入场质量并适应不同品种
将固定止损止盈改为ATR动态止损止盈，以适应市场波动性变化
improvements_en: Add position checking logic to avoid duplicate same-direction entries causing over-concentration
Implement spread and volatility filters to improve entry quality and adapt to different instruments
Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic levels to adapt to market volatility changes

risk_points: 缺少持仓数量检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
固定止损1000点在某些高波动品种上可能仍然不够，而在低波动品种上则过于宽松
依赖外部自定义指标文件，若指标缺失EA将无法运行但已有初始化检查
risk_points_en: No position count check may lead to excessive risk exposure from duplicate same-direction entries
Fixed 1000-point stop loss may be insufficient for high-volatility instruments and too wide for low-volatility ones
Dependency on external custom indicator file; EA will fail to initialize if the indicator is missing, though this is checked
